roles_defined_with_scoped_permissions.title: Roles Defined with Scoped Permissions
roles_defined_with_scoped_permissions.description: Indicates whether distinct roles exist in the system with explicitly scoped, limited permission sets rather than broad or wildcard access grants.

users_assigned_least_privilege_role.title: Users Assigned Least-Privilege Role
users_assigned_least_privilege_role.description: Indicates whether user-to-role assignments follow least privilege, meaning users are assigned only the minimal role(s) necessary for their job function with no excess permissions.

privileged_role_assignment_review_freque.title: Privileged Role Assignment Review Frequency
privileged_role_assignment_review_freque.description: How frequently privileged role assignments are formally reviewed and recertified to ensure continued appropriateness.

separation_of_duties_enforced.title: Separation of Duties Enforced
separation_of_duties_enforced.description: Indicates whether the RBAC configuration enforces separation of duties by preventing conflicting high-privilege roles from being assigned to the same user.

role_permission_enforcement_mode.title: Role Permission Enforcement Mode
role_permission_enforcement_mode.description: Indicates whether permissions are enforced strictly through role assignments or allow ad-hoc individual overrides outside of role definitions.

users_with_direct_permission_grants.title: Users With Direct Permission Grants
users_with_direct_permission_grants.description: Count of users who have been granted permissions directly (outside of role assignments), indicating ad-hoc privilege grants that bypass role-based consistency.

role_permission_audit_enabled.title: Role Permission Audit Enabled
role_permission_audit_enabled.description: Whether periodic or continuous auditing of role-to-permission assignments is enabled to detect drift or inconsistency over time.

sod_policy_enforced.title: Separation of Duties Policy Enforced
sod_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether the RBAC system actively enforces a separation of duties policy that prevents conflicting role assignments to a single user.

conflicting_role_pairs_defined.title: Number of Conflicting Role Pairs Defined
conflicting_role_pairs_defined.description: The count of explicitly defined mutually exclusive role pairs (e.g., requester/approver, initiator/reviewer) in the SoD policy configuration.

sod_enforcement_scope.title: SoD Enforcement Scope
sod_enforcement_scope.description: Describes whether SoD enforcement is applied preventively (blocking assignment at provisioning time), detectivley (alerting after the fact), or is not enforced.

role_change_logging_enabled.title: Role Change Logging Enabled
role_change_logging_enabled.description: Whether the system is configured to log role assignments, revocations, and modifications as they occur.

permission_change_log_retention_days.title: Permission Change Log Retention (Days)
permission_change_log_retention_days.description: Number of days that role and permission change logs are retained, enabling historical forensic reconstruction.

logged_event_types.title: Logged RBAC Event Types
logged_event_types.description: List of role/permission event types currently captured in audit logs (e.g., role_assigned, role_revoked, permission_modified, role_created, role_deleted).

role_based_permission_assignment.title: Role-Based Permission Assignment
role_based_permission_assignment.description: Indicates whether permissions are assigned to users exclusively through roles rather than directly to individual user accounts.

role_definition_review_frequency.title: Role Definition Review Frequency
role_definition_review_frequency.description: How frequently role definitions (memberships, permissions, and scope) are formally reviewed and recertified.

offboarding_role_revocation_automated.title: Automated Role Revocation on Offboarding
offboarding_role_revocation_automated.description: Indicates whether role membership is automatically revoked when a user is offboarded (e.g., account deprovisioned via HR integration or SCIM).

rbac_enforcement_enabled.title: RBAC Enforcement Enabled
rbac_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether role-based access control is actively enforced at the application or system layer to block unauthorized function execution and deny requests that exceed a user's assigned role permissions.

privileged_function_permission_check.title: Privileged Function Permission Check Enforcement
privileged_function_permission_check.description: How permission checks are applied to privileged or sensitive functions — whether enforced on all, some, or none of the protected operations.

default_deny_policy.title: Default Deny Policy Active
default_deny_policy.description: Whether the RBAC system denies access to functions by default unless a role explicitly grants permission (deny-by-default posture).

access_denial_logging_enabled.title: Access Denial Event Logging Enabled
access_denial_logging_enabled.description: Whether access-denial events generated by RBAC violations are captured in logs or a SIEM for detection and alerting.

least_privilege_policy_applied.title: Least Privilege Policy Applied
least_privilege_policy_applied.description: Whether roles are scoped to the minimum permissions required for each user group, reducing the blast radius of privilege escalation attempts.

federated_role_sync_enabled.title: Federated Role Synchronization Enabled
federated_role_sync_enabled.description: Whether role definitions are actively synchronized across integrated systems (e.g., LDAP/AD directories, cloud IAM, API gateways) so that changes propagate consistently.

role_policy_coverage.title: Role Policy Coverage Across Integrated Systems
role_policy_coverage.description: Extent to which the federated role policy is enforced across all integrated systems rather than only a subset.

last_sync_status.title: Last Role Synchronization Status
last_sync_status.description: Outcome of the most recent role synchronization job across federated systems.
